label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: No oirá a ustedes Faraón, a fin de multiplicar mis prodigios en tierra de Egipto.
spanish: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés: No oirá a ustedes Faraón, a fin de que se multipliquen mis prodigios en tierra de Egipto.
grammarChanges: Replaced the transitive infinitive 'multiplicar mis prodigios', which by Spanish subject control made Faraón the agent multiplying the wonders, with 'a fin de que se multipliquen mis prodigios'. This matches the intransitive sense of the Qal infinitive construct רְבוֹת ('become many'), with 'mis prodigios' as the grammatical subject that becomes many rather than an object acted on by Faraón.
readerNote: Chose the subjunctive clause 'a fin de que se multipliquen mis prodigios' over the infinitive 'multiplicar' because Spanish infinitive purpose clauses default to the main-clause subject (Faraón); the intransitive Hebrew infinitive construct needs 'mis prodigios' as its own subject.
